posts.text:
New Fox News poll.

Democrats lead 51%-44% on generic ballot among registered voters.

Among those who say they're certain to vote, it's 54%-43%.

The "real" Dem lead right now is probably ~ 9 points, and creeping up.
posts.summary: Democratic polling lead suggests momentum heading into elections

posts.quote: Open the Kennedy Center. Stop Trump's Arch.

posts.text:
Here in D.C., Trump wants to build a Great Triumphal Arch and to shutter the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts.

Chest-beating boastfulness and mindless ignorance.

The combination usually doesn't work out well.

posts.text:
A word on AI “guardrails.”

Guardrails without teeth — without enforcement mechanisms, without liability, without penalties, without the weight of government behind them — aren’t real guardrails.
posts.summary: Argues AI guardrails lack enforcement and real consequences

posts.text:
"Banning superintelligence and recursive self-improvement prevents BOTH existential risk and human disempowerment.

By just improving and refining the raw intelligence we have now, [we will have] an incredible century of medical & scientific & engineering progress."
